objective: Add action report across the TypeScript domain/API/CLI to summarize deployment attempts. Input has events:list of at most1000 {service:nonempty ASCII string, durationMs:integer0..1000000000, outcome:"success"|"failure"}, minAttempts:integer1..1000. Reject invalid shapes/types/ranges with Error; bool is not an integer. Unknown extra properties may be ignored. Return array of rows sorted by service using ordinary ascending string order, omitting services with fewer than minAttempts events. Each row is {service,attempts,successes,failures,totalMs,averageMs}, averageMs is ceiling(totalMs/attempts); sums remain exact safe integers. Validate every event before filtering. Empty events yields []. Preserve action total, its safe-integer/overflow validation, unknown-action errors, JSON stdin/stdout and CLI exit2 with nonempty stderr without stack trace for invalid input. Export dispatch from src/api.ts and compile strict CommonJS with existing tsconfig. Add at least three node:test cases runnable with node --test after compilation. Environment Node22.23.3/npm10.9.9/TypeScript5.8.3/@types/node22.15.3/undici-types6.21.0. Dependencies are prepared offline at the ancestor node_modules location; use node /node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p /path/to/project/tsconfig.json, no npm downloads. Add at least three meaningful regression tests covering normal, boundary and rejected inputs, and document new usage and error behavior in README.md (at least 40 words). Keep public interfaces and existing behavior. Standard profile dependencies only; do not fetch or change locks. Tests and documented commands must work when the project is at any filesystem location, not a fixed workspace mount. No input mutation. Exact JSON output types matter; booleans are not integers.
